title: Chapter 23: Task-aware augmentation and target geometry

entries.claim: MixUp forms convex combinations of two inputs and labels with lambda sampled from Beta(alpha,alpha)
entries.notes: The article's toy code uses a fixed lambda to make the arithmetic deterministic.

entries.claim: CutMix replaces a rectangular image patch and mixes labels in proportion to the actual patch area
entries.notes: After clipping the sampled box to image bounds, effective lambda should reflect the actual visible area.

entries.claim: Categorical segmentation masks should use nearest-neighbor interpolation to avoid inventing class IDs at boundaries
entries.notes: Continuous targets such as depth maps and heatmaps may require different interpolation.

entries.claim: Albumentations can bind boxes, keypoints and masks to synchronized geometric transforms using target parameters
entries.notes: Coordinate format, label_fields and instance filtering must match the dataset contract.
